name: MinistryPlatform
shortDescription: An ACS Technologies church system that keeps people, parish, messages and day-to-day administration data in one adjustable database.
suitableContexts: Large churches, parishes, dioceses or denominational offices
Teams with complex data, integration or custom-development requirements

pricing.summary: MinistryPlatform’s help centre directs customers to call for pricing. It has shared-cloud and dedicated-cloud editions, with optional services that may have additional monthly costs.

tiers.label: Shared Cloud
tiers.detail: Supplier describes tiers and optional services

tiers.label: Dedicated Cloud
tiers.detail: Supplier describes additional managed deployment options

editorial.assessment: MinistryPlatform is a configurable enterprise-style ChMS rather than a lightweight church database. It may fit a large or complex organisation, but its quote-based model and deployment options mean a church should only evaluate it with clear requirements, technical ownership and migration capacity.
bestFor: Large churches and multi-site organisations with complex data needs
Dioceses or networks needing a configurable shared platform
strengths: Strong stated customisation and API capability
Shared and dedicated cloud deployment options
limitations: Pricing and trial terms are not public in this review
Likely higher implementation and governance burden than a simple ChMS

longForm.verdict: MinistryPlatform is a shortlist option for complex, well-resourced organisations—not a default answer for a small church seeking a simple directory. Its flexibility is valuable only when the organisation can govern the resulting data model and integrations.

decisionLens.heading: Complexity must have a named owner.
decisionLens.text: Custom fields, APIs and cloud edition choices can solve genuine organisational problems, but they also create decisions about change control, data quality, testing and support. Define the ownership model before commissioning a demo or migration.

sections.heading: A configurable ministry data platform
sections.question: Does the organisation need configuration more than simplicity?
paragraphs: MinistryPlatform describes central people and operations data, custom fields and structures, reporting, integrations and APIs. It has shared-cloud and dedicated-cloud edition options.

Start with a requirements workshop rather than a generic demo. Ask the supplier to price the needed cloud edition, integrations, migration, training and ongoing technical services, then compare that total with less configurable alternatives.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not use an independent review score. It is based on MinistryPlatform’s official product and help-centre information.
themes: The platform’s strength is configuration and integration rather than entry-level simplicity.
Quote scope, implementation and governance determine practical fit.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier statements do not establish price, UK availability or a church’s capacity to operate a customised platform.

faq.question: How much does MinistryPlatform cost?
faq.answer: Pricing is not published in the reviewed material. The supplier directs customers to call for pricing, including cloud-edition and optional-service costs.

faq.question: Does MinistryPlatform offer a demo?
faq.answer: Yes. The supplier invites organisations to sign up for a personalised demo.

faq.question: Is MinistryPlatform for small churches?
faq.answer: It may be possible, but its published emphasis on configuration, APIs, diocesan use and cloud options makes it most relevant to complex organisations. A smaller church should compare simpler options too.
